name: Tarquin's The SeaDog Navy Strength
production: Botanicals macerated overnight in neutral spirit; violets added next morning before distillation
Diluted with demineralised Cornish spring water to 57%; nothing else added (London Dry style)
Hand-filled, hand-dipped in wax, puffin stamp
history: 2017 | 'World's Best Gin' at San Francisco World Spirits Competition
palate: Zesty tangerine, almond and violet sweetness
expressions: Tarquin's flavoured gins | 38% (Blood Orange, Rhubarb & Raspberry, etc.)
serve_official: Aromatic tonic, slice of orange, sprig of rosemary
notes: Recipe rebalances the Cornish Dry Gin botanicals with more cinnamon, liquorice and orange peel and uses a Kosovo juniper. Only 5 of 12 botanicals named here.
